# Support

This repository is open: anyone may open issues and pull requests.

**No guarantees.** This is a personal project maintained on a best-effort
basis:

- Issues are triaged when time permits; there is no response-time SLA.
- PRs are reviewed and merged at the maintainer's discretion. Small, focused,
  well-described PRs land fastest.
- Breaking changes may land between minor versions while the module is 0.x
  (SemVer 0.x rules); check the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md) before upgrading.

## Where to look first

- Usage and wiring: [README.md](README.md)
- Domain terms: [docs/DOMAIN_LANGUAGE.md](docs/DOMAIN_LANGUAGE.md)
- Internal architecture notes: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)
- Contributing: [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- Security reports: [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — never a public issue

## Good issues

Include the version (`go list -m github.com/larsartmann/go-linter-sdk`), a
minimal reproduction, and what you expected vs. what happened.
